before.test/persistence_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule PersistenceTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "save stores a new account" do
    {:ok, store} = Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end)
    row = %{id: 42, name: "Ada"}
    assert Accounts.save(store, row) == :ok
    assert Accounts.get(store, 42) == row
  end
end
